script_text: Aries, brace yourself — today's cosmic storm is charging through your 7th House of Partnerships with the force of a supernova. Mars, your ruling planet, is squaring Pluto in your 8th House of Transformation, igniting explosive power struggles in relationships that demand you wield your fiery will like a precision weapon. Single Aries, this transit attracts intense, magnetic connections — but beware the allure of power plays. Taken? Expect your partner to test your boundaries; channel this friction into deeper intimacy rather than conflict. Career-wise, Mercury in your 10th House of Public Image is trining Jupiter in Gemini, showering unexpected opportunities for recognition — but only if you avoid impulsive decisions that could derail your trajectory. The universe is gifting you a hidden blessing today: a sudden financial windfall from an unexpected source, materializing in your 2nd House of Resources. Don't ignore the warning whispers — your 1st House of Self is under a Venus-Saturn square, tempting you to overextend emotionally. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate the cosmic currents.
